name: Anderson
gaps: Source query returned 12592 rows; 12288 stayed in the 5.0–150.0 acre band after the parcel-id and geometry checks.

Parcels are Parcels (NewPropertyViewer MapServer) (https://propertyviewer.andersoncountysc.org/arcgis/rest/services/NewPropertyViewer/MapServer/5). Acreage is 5.0–150.0 inclusive. No Opportunity Zone status, school grade, or base flood elevation is stored.
qPublic and Beacon property-appraiser links are stored as patterns and were not requested.
Owner phone and email are not ingested. SCDOT AADT stays the query-time statewide join.
Owner name / mailing not on public parcel REST — use ACPASS Real Property (QryMapNo=TMS / ACPASS_LOOKUP).
TAXOWNSTR is ownership-structure code, NOT ownerName.
No dedicated acreage field — parse DESCRIPTIO or Shape.STArea()/43560.
Zoning Opengov/MAT/6 covers ~33k/120k parcels (zoned areas); unincorporated often unzoned.
